procedures.name: Main
procedures.source:
&First = new()
Print(&First.Flag)
Print(&First.Day.Year())
Print(&First.Stamp.Year())
&First.Flag = True
&First.Day = YMDToD(2024,2,29)
&First.Stamp = YMDHMSToT(2023,12,31,23,59,58)
&Second = &First
&Second.Flag = False
&Second.Day = YMDToD(2000,1,2)
&Second.Stamp = YMDHMSToT(2001,2,3,4,5,6)
Print(&First.Flag)
Print(&First.Day.Year())
Print(&First.Stamp.Year())
&Second = &First.Clone()
&Second.Flag = True
&Second.Day = YMDToD(1999,1,1)
&Second.Stamp = YMDHMSToT(1998,1,2,3,4,5)
Print(&First.Flag)
Print(&Second.Flag)
Print(&First.Day.Year())
Print(&Second.Day.Year())
Print(&First.Stamp.Year())
Print(&Second.Stamp.Year())
